description: This Java source file defines the main activity class for an Android application that manages device policies, allowing users to configure device administration policies, view current policies, and activate device administration. The class manages UI screens, handles user interactions for setting password policies, activating device admin, and launching secure content.

classes.name: PolicySetupActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing device policy setup and viewing screens, handling user interaction for policy configuration, activation, and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and the Policy object.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Restores UI state based on saved preferences and device admin status.

methods.name: setScreenContent
methods.description: Sets current layout, updates preferences, and initializes relevant UI components.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Saves current policy if on setup screen.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from device admin activation intent and restores UI state.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Manages back navigation, reverting from view screen to setup screen.

methods.name: initPolicySetupScreen
methods.description: Initializes UI controls for policy configuration and populates from stored policy.

methods.name: initViewPolicyScreen
methods.description: Displays the current policy settings on view-only screen.

methods.name: initNavigation
methods.description: Sets up dynamic navigation message and action button based on policy and admin status.

methods.name: mActivateButtonListener
methods.description: Listener for device admin activation button; triggers activation intent after saving policy.

methods.name: mEnforcePolicyListener
methods.description: Listener for enforcing password policy, launching system password setup.

methods.name: setupNavigation
methods.description: Configures navigation message, button text, and click listener.

methods.name: writePolicy
methods.description: Reads policy input fields and saves the configuration into local storage.
